item.title: Beijing Yanqi Lake View Hotel: Lakeside Room + Breakfast for 2 Adults + 1 Child — ¥766 (≈$108)
item.description:
Deal price: premium or deluxe room for 1 night — ¥766 (≈$108, was ¥1,299, about 41% off) · Valid Nov 5, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · No surcharge on New Year’s Day or Spring Festival

China State Construction Yanqi Lake View Hotel （中建雁栖湖景酒店） sits right on Yanqi Lake in Huairou, 60 km from central Beijing — the lake’s north gate is just 300 metres from the hotel, and the autumn colours on the water are the reason to go now. This Double 11 package covers a premium or deluxe king or twin room for one night, breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.4 m), two coffees, and use of the pool, kids’ castle and gym, with free parking and WiFi. A two-night option at ¥1,499 (≈$211, was ¥1,999) can be used as 1 room for 2 nights or 2 rooms for 1 night.

item.title: Shanghai Yaoxue Snow World: Unlimited Skiing for Two + Hot Springs — ¥999 (≈$141)
item.description:
Deal price: unlimited intermediate/advanced skiing for two + hot spring visit for two — ¥999 (≈$141, was ¥1,396, about 28% off) · Valid Nov 3 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book one day ahead

Yaoxue Snow World （耀雪冰雪世界） in Lingang is a 98,000㎡ indoor snow park held at −3 to −5°C all year — real snow, indoors, in Shanghai. There are five slopes: two beginner runs (the green run and the practice slope) plus blue, red and black runs for intermediate and advanced skiers, with a magic carpet and an indoor cable car. The headline ¥999 ticket covers unlimited time on the intermediate/advanced slopes for two people, with one gear rental each (ski suit, skis or snowboard, boots, poles and helmet, no deposit), plus a hot spring visit for two at the Crowne Plaza hotel next door (bring swimwear).

item.title: Xiamen Lingling Circus City: Animal Kingdom Ticket ¥79 (≈$11) or Circus Show + Zoo ¥159 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: Animal Kingdom ticket — ¥79 (≈$11, was ¥140, about 44% off) · Circus show ticket with same-day zoo entry — ¥159 (≈$22, was ¥280) · On sale Nov 7–20, 2026 · Valid for any day to Dec 31, 2026

Lingling International Circus City （灵玲国际马戏城） in Jimei is Xiamen’s big family day out: a zoo and a world-class circus in one park. The Animal Kingdom is home to giant pandas, giraffes, brown bears, white tigers, alpacas, parrots and ring-tailed lemurs — the animals head indoors at 17:00, so go earlier in the day. The circus show, Forest Secrets, plays in a Guinness-record big-top theatre with a water-and-land dual stage, fountains and fire effects, and the Kenyan Death Wheel act, newly upgraded from 4 wheels to 6 and raised to 17 metres. The ¥159 ticket covers the circus show and includes same-day entry to the Animal Kingdom, so one ticket does the whole park.

item.title: Yujian Minnan, Xiamen: Family Ticket for 1 Adult + 2 Kids — ¥99 (≈$14)
item.description:
Deal price: family ticket for 1 adult + 2 kids — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥286, about 65% off) · Valid Nov 4–30, 2026 · Book 30 minutes ahead

Yujian Minnan （屿见闽南） is an immersive theme park in Huli District that drops you into old coastal Fujian: Minnan-style streets and courtyards, costumed NPC characters wandering the park to chat and play, live performances, and a stamp-collection game — gather the stamps and the kids can redeem a souvenir popsicle. It is all indoors, so it works in any weather, and it photographs beautifully in traditional dress. This autumn family ticket covers 1 adult plus 2 children (one aged 16 or under, one aged 6 or under).

item.title: Zhangzhou Longjia Hot Spring Resort: 8 Hot Spring Visits + 8 Buffet Dinners — ¥1,111 (≈$156)
item.description:
Deal price: 8 hot spring visits + 8 buffet dinners — ¥1,111 (≈$156, was ¥3,088, about 64% off) · Valid Nov 4, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Hot springs daily, buffet dinner Fri–Sun

Longjia Eco Hot Spring Resort （龙佳生态温泉山庄） in Jiaomei, about 25 km from Zhangzhou and an easy drive from Xiamen, is a 200,000㎡ garden-style hot spring resort built in Tang-palace garden style around 40,000㎡ of landscaped hot springs. Zhangzhou is officially rated a “China Hot Spring City”, and Longjia has been the area’s best-known hot spring resort for over 20 years, with 30+ pools across hydrotherapy, herbal-medicine, petal and fish-therapy zones. This Double 11 bundle covers 8 hot spring visits and 8 buffet dinners — about ¥139 per visit-and-dinner pair.

item.title: Guizhou Astronomy & Caving Family Tour from ¥3,380 (≈$470): 5 Days / 4 Nights, FAST Telescope, Miao Village & Cave Rope Adventure
item.description:
Deal price: 5-day / 4-night tour, child — from ¥3,380 (≈$470; adult from ¥3,980) · Departures Nov 11–21, 2026 and Jan 23 – Feb 11, 2027 · One family minimum to run

This is a proper expedition, not a sightseeing bus: five days across Guizhou built around the FAST radio telescope — the world’s largest single-dish telescope — plus a real caving descent on ropes, a Miao village visit and hands-on geology, led by an astronomy professor, cave coaches and a geology guide. Days run from Guiyang to Pingtang (FAST) and Kaili (caves and Miao culture), with a professional family-tour leader and a photographer along.

item.title: Maoshan Yihe Peninsula HENTIQUE Resort from ¥499 (≈$69): Lakeside Stay + Hot Spring or Salt Lake Tickets, Valid to Jan 2027
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + Wangyou Valley hot-spring tickets — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥899, about 44% off) · Valid through Jan 31, 2027 · Refundable if unbooked

Maoshan Yihe Peninsula Resort (HENTIQUE) sits on the shore of Maoshan Lake in Jintan, Changzhou — a one-stop family break: lake-view rooms, a petting zoo where kids can feed rabbits and mini pigs, and your pick of Wangyou Valley hot spring, Oriental Salt Lake City, the Maoshan scenic area or Maoshan Forest World, all bundled with breakfast. Book at least a day ahead; check-in 14:00, checkout noon.

item.title: Qingdao Sunac Land 2-Day Ticket — ¥69 (≈$10): 10 Rides Unlimited, Valid to Nov 15
item.description:
Deal price: 2-day ticket, 10 rides unlimited — ¥69 (≈$10, was ¥158, about 56% off) · Valid Nov 5–15, 2026 · Use on 2 consecutive days

Qingdao Sunac Land (in Sunac Mall, Huangdao) is offering a 2-day autumn-break ticket at less than half price: ¥69 covers 10 rides, unlimited, across two consecutive days — you cannot split the two days. The line-up: Laoshan Flying Dragon coaster, carousel, pirate ship, kids’ driving school, crazy pendulum, rolling music boat, bumper cars, basket Ferris wheel, samba balloons and the sky-drop tower. Buy and use — no ticket exchange needed.

item.title: Xiamen Yubaofu Boiled Live Fish Set Meal for 3–4 People — ¥138 (≈$19), Free Island-Wide Delivery
item.description:
Deal price: boiled live fish set for 3–4 people — ¥138 (≈$19, was ¥269, about 49% off) · Valid through Dec 31, 2026 · Delivery or pickup — no dine-in

Yubaofu （鱼宝福） in Wenzhao is one of Xiamen’s busiest boiled-fish restaurants — the kind of place locals queue for. This deal brings the signature dish to you: a whole fresh live fish, cooked in a bubbling spicy broth with plenty of sides, enough for 3–4 people at about ¥35 a head, with a big bottle of Coke included. It is delivery or pickup only — there is no dine-in on this deal. Delivery is free anywhere on Xiamen island (except Gulangyu), or pick it up from the Wenzhao shop yourself. Book 4 hours ahead; usable 09:00–13:30 and 16:00–21:00.

item.title: Yichun Snow RV Family Tour from ¥4,980 (≈$692): 6 Days / 5 Nights, Ski Lessons, Ice Fishing & Reindeer Tribe
item.description:
Deal price: 6-day / 5-night snow RV tour, child — from ¥4,980 (≈$692; adult from ¥5,980, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Departures Jan 19 – Feb 21, 2027 · One family per RV

This is winter in Heilongjiang done properly: six days from Harbin into the snow country around Yichun, travelling in a heated snow-themed RV — one family to a vehicle — through the Lesser Khingan forest. The trip packs in a 1-on-1 ski lesson, ice fishing and a winter-catch demonstration, reindeer interaction and feeding, an Oroqen tribe visit, a snowfield hotpot glamping lunch, and 10+ snow activities, with a guide, a safety host and a photographer along the way. Nights are in 5-diamond Harbin hotels and Yichun resorts, not in the RV.

item.title: Beijing Badaling Hilton Doubletree from ¥549 (≈$76): Hot Spring, Kids' Park & Wild Duck Lake Tickets, Great Wall Nearby
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night hot-spring & play package — ¥549 (≈$76, was ¥999, about 45% off) · Valid Nov 6, 2026 – Mar 30, 2027 · No weekend surcharge · Refundable if unreserved

Beijing Badaling Hilton Doubletree sits in the centre of Yanqing — Beijing’s “summer capital” — about 20 km from the Badaling Great Wall and close to Longqing Gorge and Wild Duck Lake Wetland Park. It’s a 2021 hotel with 276 rooms; the premium rooms run about 40 m² with a 1.8 m king bed or two 1.35 m twins. This Double-11 deal packs a lot into one night: breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.2 m), hot-spring tickets for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.3 m) at the Shiyuan Yueqin Hot Spring — a roughly 10,000 m² spring centre with 30+ pools — plus kids’ park tickets, a traditional-craft session and 2 adult tickets to Wild Duck Lake Wetland Park. The hotel itself adds a kids’ club, a heated indoor pool and a gym, and a welcome cookie on arrival.

item.title: Beijing Chocolate Museum from ¥29.9 (≈$4): Single Ticket with Stamp Booklet, was ¥198 — Family Ticket ¥198 with DIY
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult single ticket (with stamp booklet) — ¥29.9 (≈$4, was ¥198, about 85% off) · Valid Apr 2 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use instantly · Refundable anytime

The Chocolate Museum (巧克巧蔻, Beijing branch) is a small, sweet museum that mixes chocolate art appreciation, chocolate knowledge, hands-on experiences and a boutique shop — a light, fun stop that works well with kids on a Beijing city day. The single ticket includes a stamp booklet to collect as you go around; the family ticket adds a proper hands-on element, with an advanced DIY session where you make your own chocolates (six pieces, plus a cherry chocolate) and two stamp booklets.

item.title: Harbin & Yichun Winter Family Tour from ¥3,980 (≈$553): 6 Days / 5 Nights, 2 Nights in Harbin, Ski Lessons, Ice Fishing & Jade Hot Spring
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥3,980 per child (≈$553, was ¥4,980, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Adults from ¥4,980 (≈$692) · Departures Jan 19 – Feb 21, 2027 · Confirm with customer service after booking

This is the closest bookable way into Harbin’s ice season on the platform right now: the tour spends 2 nights in Harbin (Steigenberger, or Crowne Plaza as the alternative), then heads 4 hours east into the snow forests of Yichun in the Lesser Khingan Mountains. One thing to know upfront: the Harbin Ice and Snow World visit is on your own time during the Harbin free time — its ticket is not included in the tour price. What is included is the Northeast Tiger Park, the ski lessons, the ice carnival and the hot spring below. The Harbin nights give you the time to visit the Ice and Snow World, St Sophia Cathedral and Central Street yourself — the hotel is about 15 minutes from the Ice and Snow World.

item.title: Inner Mongolia Keshiketeng Snow Family Tour from ¥3,080 (≈$428): 6 Days / 5 Nights, Chongli Ski Lessons, Winter Fishing & Reindeer Tribe
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥3,080 per child (≈$428, was ¥3,980, early-bird ¥900 off) · Adults from ¥3,680 (≈$511) · Departures Dec 19, 2026 – Jan 20, 2027 · Confirm with customer service after booking

This is not a hotel deal — it is a 6-day guided snow journey into Inner Mongolia, built around one idea: the “fire” of the northern winter. The route runs from Beijing to the Chongli ski resort (a 2022 Winter Olympics venue), then deep into the snowfields of Ulan Butong and Keshiketeng. It is the only December-departure northern snow tour on the booking platform right now, and the pace is deliberately slow — fewer stops, more time in each place — which matters at minus twenty degrees with kids in tow.

item.title: Longyan Qingshui Tianyi Hot Spring Resort from ¥299 (≈$42): 1 Night + Breakfast & Unlimited Hot Springs for 2, was ¥1,299
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, annex mountain room with private tub — ¥299 (≈$42, was ¥1,299, about 77% off) · Valid Nov 5, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Double-11 flash-sale tiers · Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Qingshui Tianyi Hot Spring Resort sits in the green mountains of Liancheng County, Longyan — about a 3-hour drive from Xiamen, and roughly 15 minutes from the 5A-rated Guan Zhai Mountain scenic area and the Peitian Hakka ancient village. The resort is built around a large semi-open-air hot-spring park themed on Hakka culture, with 50+ pools — lavender, milk bath, fish therapy, herbal soaks — plus a spa house, an outdoor pool and a wave pool. Every room has natural hot-spring water piped in, with its own private soaking tub, so you can bathe without leaving the room.

item.title: Nanjing Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel from ¥499 (≈$69): Garden Hotel Inside Laomendong, Near Confucius Temple
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night Yayun room — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥999, 50% off) · Valid Aug 26 – Dec 30, 2026 · Fri–Sat +¥150/room/night · Refundable if unreserved

Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel is a garden hotel with a story: it restores the Jiezi Garden, the private garden built 300 years ago in Nanjing by Li Yu — the Ming–Qing literati behind the classic painting manual The Mustard Seed Garden Manual of Painting and the essay collection Idle Thoughts. The hotel sits inside the Laomendong scenic area, about 1 km on foot from Confucius Temple and about 620 m from Wudingmen metro station. Outside the gate is the busy old street, full of snacks and shops; inside is a quiet Jiangnan garden of pavilions, ponds and winding stone paths. The garden itself is open to the public by day, but in the early morning and evening it belongs to guests alone — and the hotel has its own passage into it.

item.title: Paradox Museum Shanghai (The Bund) from ¥59 (≈$8): Single Ticket to 50+ Immersive Illusion Experiences, was ¥158
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult single ticket — ¥59 (≈$8, was ¥158, about 63% off) · Valid Nov 6 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use instantly · Refundable anytime · Money-Saver Card saves another ¥30

Paradox Museum has just opened its Bund branch in the heart of the Nanjing East Road pedestrian street — inside Central Plaza, a short walk from the Bund waterfront. It is a walk-through illusion museum: 50+ immersive paradox exhibits built around optical illusions, reversed rooms and hands-on trickery, designed to be photographed as much as looked at. It is a compact, one-hour-style stop rather than a half-day museum, which makes it an easy add-on between the Bund and Nanjing Road shopping.

item.title: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel from ¥999 (≈$139): 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Park Tickets for 2 Adults, was ¥1,290
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, deluxe room + 2-day unlimited park tickets for 2 adults — ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,290, about 23% off) · Valid Oct 17, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Double-11 deal · Refundable if unreserved

Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel is the stay-inside-the-park option at Haichang Ocean Park in Lingang, Pudong: you sleep steps from the gates, enter through a dedicated VIP channel, and get two days of unlimited park entry for two adults (family tiers add one child under 1.4 m). The headline tier adds breakfast for two the next morning, free parking and Wi-Fi, and the current Ocean Wonders Festival (魔都海洋万秀节, through Nov 15) — two brand-new haunted houses, a new Arabian-style riverside street, 150 roaming performers, a night-time orca show and a mermaid light show, plus six refreshed big ocean shows and 100,000+ marine animals across the park.

item.title: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Tickets from ¥99 (≈$14): Orca Show, Birthday & Student Deals
item.description:
Deal price: birthday or student ticket — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥299 for birthday / ¥150 for student) · Adult ticket ¥229 (≈$32, was ¥299) · November dates, buy at least 1 day ahead · Refundable if unused

Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park is Shanghai’s big ocean park, home to about 100,000 marine animals — the headline is the orca show “The Legend of the Killer Whale”, plus dolphins, beluga whales, sea lions and a polar bear, across six ocean shows. The park’s Ocean Show Festival runs to November 15, with a fireworks show on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights, and a new Arabian-themed riverside zone with 200 performers and 200+ games. Park hours in November: 9:30–21:00 for Nov 1–15, 9:30–19:00 for Nov 16–30.

item.title: Suzhou Paradise Forest World Annual Pass from ¥365 (≈$51): 30+ Rides, Family Pass ¥798, Valid to Dec 2027
item.description:
Deal price: single annual pass — ¥365 (≈$51, was ¥888, about 59% off) · Activate by Dec 31, 2027 · Valid from activation to Dec 31, 2027 · Refundable if unactivated

Suzhou Paradise Forest World is a forest-themed park with 30+ rides and attractions, and kids’ facilities make up a good share of them — a solid pick if you live in or near Suzhou and go to theme parks more than once a year. One pass covers unlimited visits from the day you activate it through December 31, 2027, so even two visits beat the single-day price. Park hours are 9:15–17:15, with night sessions on holidays per the park’s notice.

item.title: Tianjin Jingji Shengguang Hot Spring Resort from ¥499 (≈$69): Hot Spring or Kids' Park, 2-Night Deal ¥719
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night family hot-spring package — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥899, about 44% off) · Valid Nov 5, 2026 – Dec 31, 2027 · No weekend surcharge · Refundable if unreserved

Jingji Shengguang Hot Spring Resort is in Jizhou, the green north of Tianjin that Beijingers call their “back garden” — about a 2-hour drive from Beijing, near Mount Pan, the Great Wall and a ski park. The hotel has 267 rooms, including cartoon-themed family rooms; the deluxe rooms are about 50 m² with lake and mountain views and a big bathtub. Its centrepiece is the Changmingyuan Hot Spring, a jungle-style garden spring billed as a “northern Sanya”: 15 indoor pools plus 6 outdoor ones at 39–42 °C, with herbal baths and the local maifanshi (longevity-stone) filtered water. For kids there is a 1,100 m² indoor play park — naughty castle, DIY crafts, sandpit, trampoline, slides and a mini train — plus a 15 × 25 m indoor pool (28 °C for adults, 29 °C for kids) and a 1,000 m² Four Seasons Garden under a glass dome that stays warm through winter.

item.title: W Xiamen NINE Buffet from ¥158 (≈$22): German Food Theme Lunch or Dinner, 1 Adult + 1 Kid Under 1.4 m Free
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult buffet lunch, Fri–Sun — ¥158 (≈$22, was ¥268, about 41% off) · Valid Nov 7 – Dec 31, 2026 · Each adult brings 1 child under 1.4 m free · Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

NINE restaurant at W Xiamen is marking the hotel’s 5th anniversary with a buffet deal built around a rotating food theme — and right now that theme is German food, running through November 30. Expect the live grill station (steak, German sausages), a seafood spread (big prawns, mussels, scallops, oysters — the garlic-grilled oysters get singled out), sashimi and sushi cut to order, Chinese and Western hot dishes, fresh soups, and a dessert table that riffs on Xiamen’s dice-game (博饼) tradition. Dinner adds hairy crab and the house “circle sausage”, and an autumn/winter hotpot option has just joined the menu.

item.title: Dongguan San Zheng Banshan Hotel from ¥399 (≈$56): Garden Rooms, Buffet Meals & a Jungle Water Slide
item.description:
Deal price: garden room + breakfast + eco-park tickets — ¥399 (≈$56, was ¥999) · 2 adults + 2 children · Valid September 17 – December 31, 2026

San Zheng Banshan sits in the hills of Qiaotou, Dongguan, looking out over gardens and a 300-mu lotus lake — a proper wind-down base about 30 minutes from downtown Dongguan. Every tier covers 2 adults + 2 children (one child under 1.4 m stays free), and the headline ¥399 tier already bundles a garden room, breakfast for the family and two tickets to Qiaotou Eco-Park. Step up to ¥599 and the buffet dinner joins in: salmon and tuna sashimi, sushi, teppanyaki cooked to order (steak, chicken, fish), hotpot and a dessert table.

item.title: Hangzhou Wind Valley Grassland Play Pass from ¥99 (≈$14): Trains, Rides & Slides on 3,000 Mu of Grassland
item.description:
Deal price: child play pass — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥228) · Adult pass ¥168 · Valid September 1 – December 20, 2026 · Buy and use the same day

Wind Valley （风之谷） is 3,000 mu of open grassland in the hills of Lin’an, about 90 minutes’ drive from central Hangzhou — the place guests keep calling “Hangzhou’s Altay”. One pass covers entry plus the grassland train and mini train (“the train to autumn”) and 10+ rides: the jungle flyer, New Zealand scooter, rainbow slide, bamboo raft, grass flying, bumper cars, tank battle and more. Two rides — the sky flyer and the super slide — need riders 1.4 m and up. Tents dot the grassland if you want to slow down between rides, and the site runs interactive activities through the day.

item.title: Sanya Bay voco Hotel 2-Night Family Stay from ¥1,288 (≈$181): IHG Beachfront on the Coconut Dream Corridor
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights in a Superior King/Twin room (balcony) — ¥1,288 (≈$181, was ¥1,788) · Valid October 19, 2026 – June 30, 2027 · Double 11 promotion

The voco Sanya Bay is IHG’s lifestyle brand on the Coconut Dream Corridor — the golden beachfront strip of Sanya Bay. Step out of the hotel and you are about 50 metres from the sand and the sea; the airport is roughly 15 minutes away and the high-speed rail station about 20, and Tianya Haijiao, West Island, Nanshan Temple, Dadonghai and Luhuitou are all easy day trips. The hotel has 233 rooms, each with a smart toilet and Elemis toiletries, and its all-day restaurant serves buffet breakfast and dinner plus Mediterranean, Spanish and Cantonese dishes and local Hainan flavours.

item.title: Suzhou Jingzhi Farm Harvest Half-Day Camp ¥98 (≈$14) for 1 Adult + 1 Child: Rice Cutting, Scarecrows & Farm Games
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 12) half-day camp — ¥98 (≈$14, was ¥128) · Valid October 24 – December 13, 2026 · 09:00–16:00

Autumn turns the rice paddies gold at Jingzhi Farm （鲸治·部落生态循环农场）, an eco-farm in Linhu, Wuzhong — and this half-day camp drops the family right into the harvest. The morning runs on farm work and farm games: a grain talk and farm-tool intro, rice cutting and threshing, scarecrow making, tug-of-war, egg tapping, a paper-plane contest, goose ring toss and pet feeding. Between games there is a rice-paddy oil-painting photo stop, a paddy maze treasure hunt and the farm’s net-famous rice-paddy swing, and every adult gets a free Americano. The egg-tapping game has a real stake: beat the other families and the day’s “egg champion” takes home a free-range chicken if 30+ families are playing (or 10 eggs if fewer); the paper-plane winner takes home stream-tracing tickets for next year.

item.title: Xiamen Portman Seven Star Bay Buffet from ¥219 (≈$31) for 1 Adult + 1 Child: Lunch or Weekday Dinner
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.2 m), lunch or weekday dinner — ¥219 (≈$31, was ¥298) · Valid July 15 – December 30, 2026 · Book at least 1 day ahead

The Portman Seven Star Bay （佰翔波特曼七星湾酒店） sits on the Tong’an coast in Xiamen, and its Le Wei all-day restaurant runs the hotel buffet: lunch 12:00–14:30 every day, dinner 17:30–21:00 (weekdays on this voucher; weekends need the weekend-dinner tier). The spread rotates with the season, but the shape stays the same — seafood, Chinese and Western dishes, and French-style desserts — and the restaurant will make baby food (steamed egg, white congee) for the smallest diners. One child under 1.2 m eats free with each adult; children 1.2–1.4 m take the child ticket, and anyone over 1.4 m pays the adult price.

item.title: Beijing Bird Paradise Exploration Park from ¥59.9 (≈$8): Forest Bird Encounters in Wenyu River Park
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥59.9 (≈$8, was ¥129) · 1 adult + 1 child ¥99 (was ¥199), 2 adults + 1 child ¥139 (was ¥299) · Opened September 2026 in Wenyu River Park · Valid September 17 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ buy and use on the spot, refundable if unused

Opened in September 2026 inside Wenyu River Park’s Chaoyang demonstration area, the Bird Paradise Exploration Park blends native forest, bird shows, petting animals and wooden playgrounds into one family day out. The centrepiece is the parrot stunt show — trained parrots ride tiny bicycles, play basketball and bowl, presented by a team with 20+ years of bird training — followed by close-up feeding and photos with macaws and cockatoos. The petting farm has alpacas, raccoons, sika deer and rabbits to feed under keeper supervision, and the forest playgrounds are all wooden and unpowered: a giant grasshopper slide and butterfly climbing frame for ages 3–6, a shallow stream area for splashing and catching fish, and a giant bird-nest climbing tower with rope bridges and spiral slides for ages 6+.

item.title: Hangzhou Koala Jungle Adventure from ¥99 (≈$14): Treetop Ropes Courses in the Forest at Senbo Resort
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket, any 2 of 3 courses — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥128) · All 3 courses ¥129 (was ¥188) · Valid September 15 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ buy by 23:59 the day before

Inside Hangzhou Senbo Resort by Xiang Lake, Koala Jungle is a 4,000-square-metre treetop adventure park: 40+ crossings strung through the forest — suspension bridges, a Tarzan jump, high swings and a 70-metre Andes zipline — plus a 12-metre climbing wall. The equipment is French-imported, and coaches supervise every course. Three routes run by difficulty: green (1.2 m+), blue (1.2 m+) and red (1.4 m+), so families can start easy and work up; children 1.2 m and under do the green and blue routes with a parent alongside. A free resort shuttle runs from the hotel lobby to the course.

item.title: Hangzhou Paradise Double-11 Tickets from ¥99.9 (≈$14): Single ¥99.9 or Double ¥169.9, Entry from Noon
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥99.9 (≈$14, was ¥190) · Double ticket ¥169.9 (≈$24, was ¥380) · Entry from 12:00 · Valid November 2–30, 2026 · ⏰ buy at least 1 day ahead, refundable if unused

Hangzhou Paradise is one of the Yangtze Delta’s big all-round theme parks, split into themed zones — Maya Tribe, Lost Jungle, Adventure Island — with dozens of thrill rides, kids’ rides and live shows. The headline rides are the Maya Roller Coaster (an 800-metre red dragon hitting 80 km/h), the 60-metre Rain God Hammer swing, the Wind God Hand, a white-water flume, bumper cars and a carousel, plus a carnival parade with floats and performers. One ticket covers the whole park for the afternoon.
